promo_campaigns.title: Promo campaigns
promo_campaigns.subtitle: Letter campaigns with Excel import, DOCX letters and email.
promo_campaigns.slug_hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (e.g. wallonie-wave-1). Uppercase is converted automatically.
promo_campaigns.slug_invalid: Use only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (e.g. wallonie-wave-1).
promo_campaigns.name: Name
promo_campaigns.copy_lead: Letter, email and column mapping are copied. Recipients and sends are not.
promo_campaigns.delete_lead: Permanently deletes this campaign, including recipients, logs, queued emails and generated letters. This cannot be undone.
promo_campaigns.delete_confirm_body: This promo campaign and all related data will be permanently deleted. Are you sure?
promo_campaigns.youtube_url_hint: Full YouTube link. Use {{youtube_thumbnail}} in the email body to show the video preview, or paste the same link as a regular link.
promo_campaigns.letter_lead: Full letter text. Signature and QR stay fixed at the bottom. Use placeholders; put {{flow_image}} where the flow image should appear.
promo_campaigns.email_placeholders_hint: In the email body you can use the same placeholders as in the letter. For welcome tracking, {{welcome_url}} is the key one. For a YouTube preview use {{youtube_thumbnail}} (with YouTube link in settings).
promo_campaigns.youtube_thumbnail_how_to: Enter a YouTube link above and place {{youtube_thumbnail}} in the email body where the preview should appear. When sent, the video thumbnail is shown automatically (clickable to YouTube). You can also add a YouTube link as a regular link in the email; it will be shown as a preview too.
promo_campaigns.welcome_url_how_to: In the email body, use {{welcome_url}} for the welcome page or {{promo_url}} for the chosen sector landing. Each recipient automatically gets a unique URL with a tracking token. Clicks appear under Visit statistics.
promo_campaigns.import_lead: Upload a .xlsx file. Invalid addresses and previously bounced or unsubscribed addresses are not stored as email; the row (name/address) remains for letters. A new import replaces all recipients.
promo_campaigns.imported_detail_skipped: :count recipients imported from :filename. :kept email(s) kept, :skipped skipped.
promo_campaigns.test_email_lead: Sends a sample email to one address.
promo_campaigns.test_email_to_hint: For test email only — not used for bulk send.
promo_campaigns.test_email_always_available: Test email still works when bulk sending is paused or promo emails are disabled.
promo_campaigns.delay_seconds_hint: Pause between emails. Cloud86 SMTP: at least 20 sec (~250 emails/hour).
promo_campaigns.queue_lead: Queues all letters; cron processes them one by one.
promo_campaigns.queue_confirm_body: :count email(s) will be queued to the addresses from Excel.
promo_campaigns.queue_confirm_skipped: :skipped recipient(s) will be skipped (no email, unsubscribed, bounced, or already sent).
promo_campaigns.pause_all_lead: Removes all waiting promo emails from the queue. Already sent mail stays sent. Sending stops automatically at 23:00 (Brussels) and immediately on a Spamhaus/DBL listing. Resume during the day, then queue emails again.
promo_campaigns.pause_all_confirm_body: Waiting emails will leave the queue. Already sent emails stay sent.
promo_campaigns.pause_confirm_body: Waiting emails for this campaign will leave the queue. Already sent emails stay sent.
promo_campaigns.paused_banner: Sending is paused. Resume, then queue emails again.
promo_campaigns.paused_reason_domain_block: Stopped automatically: our sender/domain is on a blocklist (e.g. Spamhaus DBL) according to a bounce.
promo_campaigns.paused_notice: Sending paused. :purged email(s) removed from the queue.
promo_campaigns.resumed_notice: Sending is allowed again. Queue emails again for the remainder.
promo_campaigns.localhost_blocked: Generate letters on production (no localhost QR).
promo_campaigns.test_email_invalid: Enter a valid test email address.
promo_campaigns.test_email_no_target: Import at least one recipient first.
promo_campaigns.test_email_missing_body: Fill in the email subject and body first.
promo_campaigns.visit_stats_lead: Link hits may be mail filters. Confirmed = someone stayed on the page; return = came back later; follow-through = register, contact or a product page.
promo_campaigns.visit_stats_totals: :welcome welcome hits · :promo landing hits · :with_visits recipients with a hit
promo_campaigns.visit_stats_empty: No visits via campaign links yet.
promo_campaigns.delivery_stats: :sent sent · :remaining left to send · :failed failed · :bounced bounced (:bounce_percent%) · :queued queued
promo_campaigns.delivery_bounce_kinds: :unknown unknown address · :blacklist blacklist · :mailbox_full mailbox full · :spam rejected as spam · :domain_block domain listed · :other other
promo_campaigns.delivery_restart_hint: Open the campaign and queue emails again (without Resend). Only the remainder will be sent.
promo_campaigns.delivery_sending_hint: Queue is still running. Auto-refreshes; leave it alone.
promo_campaigns.delivery_paused_hint: Queue was cleared (manually, at 23:00, or after a Spamhaus listing). Resume during the day and queue emails again.
promo_campaigns.bounces_lead: Scan the promo mailbox for undelivered/bounce messages, including already opened mail from the last 30 days. New bounces every 5 minutes; full scan hourly. A Spamhaus/DBL listing stops sending immediately.
promo_campaigns.bounces_queued: Bounce scan queued. The list refreshes automatically (usually within a minute).
promo_campaigns.bounces_none: Done: no bounces found in :scanned messages (last :days days, including already read).
promo_campaigns.bounces_processed: Done: :scanned messages scanned, :bounces bounces, :emails addresses found, :removed marked undelivered, :blocked unsubscribed.
promo_campaigns.landing_hint: {{promo_url}} opens this landing with the recipient tracking token. Choose the landing that matches the campaign.
promo_campaigns.email_plain_hint: No logo or branded template: plain HTML, left-aligned. Footer is only a line and Unsubscribe (List-Unsubscribe kept).
promo_campaigns.force_send_hint: Resends to previously sent addresses using the current email text (saved campaign). Bounced/unsubscribed addresses stay skipped.

manual_screenshots.title: Manual screenshots
manual_screenshots.subtitle: Static PNGs for the manual — generated with Playwright (usually locally on Windows).
manual_screenshots.intro: After a UI change: npm run build, run capture, commit PNGs. See docs/MANUAL_SCREENSHOTS.md for the full runbook.
workflow_steps: Set MANUAL_CAPTURE_* in .env (same URL as APP_URL, stable tenant IDs/tokens).
Production: git pull — no Chromium needed on shared hosting.
manual_screenshots.workflow_doc: Full runbook for developers and Cursor agents:
manual_screenshots.not_configured: MANUAL_CAPTURE_EMAIL and MANUAL_CAPTURE_PASSWORD are missing in .env.
manual_screenshots.already_running: A screenshot run is already in progress.
manual_screenshots.failed: Screenshot run failed. See status below.

translation_sync.title: Translations
translation_sync.subtitle: Pull pending translations (issues, announcements, units, checklists, tasks, documents and assistant knowledge base) from the server, translate locally via Ollama, and push them back.
translation_sync.intro: One click: export on the server (approved issues, active announcements/units/documents/checklists and tasks with a description), download, Ollama translation with progress, upload and immediate import. Translating runs in batches: each batch is imported on the server right away, so an interrupted run does not lose the work already done. On the server, a cron re-processes import files every hour.
translation_sync.setup_hint: Set TRANSLATION_SYNC_ENABLED=true and fill TRANSLATION_SYNC_SSH_* in .env (local). Set QUEUE_CONNECTION=database and run php artisan queue:work in PowerShell (not sync via Apache).
translation_sync.sync_queue_warning: QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync: SSH does not work via Apache. Use database in .env and run php artisan queue:work in PowerShell.
translation_sync.reminder_body: Pending translations (issues, announcements, units, checklists, tasks and documents) must run on your laptop via Platform → Translations (Ollama). The server does not translate automatically.
translation_sync.reminder_local: Run translations via Platform → Translations (Ollama) — for example after new content on the server that received translation slots.
translation_sync.reminder_pending: :count translation(s) still waiting on your laptop.
translation_sync.reminder_none: No pending translations on the server.
translation_sync.server_only_message: Translations run on the local computer, not on the internet server.
translation_sync.not_enabled: TRANSLATION_SYNC_ENABLED is off or SSH settings are missing.
translation_sync.not_configured: TRANSLATION_SYNC_SSH_HOST, SSH_USER or REMOTE_PATH is missing in .env.
translation_sync.already_running: A translation run is already in progress.
translation_sync.failed: Translation run failed. See status below.
translation_sync.completed_summary: :imported of :total translations imported on the server.
translation_sync.nothing_pending: No pending translations on the server.
translation_sync.error_nothing_translated: No export rows could be translated. Restart the queue worker after a code update (Ctrl+C, then php artisan queue:work again) and retry.
translation_sync.error_partial_translated: Only :translated of :total export rows were translated — check Ollama and restart the queue worker after git pull.
translation_sync.error_remote_import_zero: The server imported 0 translations. Check that migrate and git pull have been run on the server.
translation_sync.error_remote_import_partial: The server imported only :imported of :total translations.
translation_sync.stalled: The translation run appears stuck (no recent updates). Check that php artisan queue:work is still running in PowerShell. SSH/SCP may hang after translating.
translation_sync.reset_stuck_done: Status cleared. Start again if queue:work is still running.
translation_sync.reset_stuck_cancelling: Status cleared. Close queue:work in PowerShell with Ctrl+C if it is still running, then start again.
translation_sync.stop_confirm: Are you sure you want to stop the running translation sync?
translation_sync.stop_requested: Stop requested — waiting for the current step to finish.
translation_sync.cancelling_hint: The worker stops once the current step finishes (SSH may take a while). Taking too long? Clear status and close queue:work in PowerShell with Ctrl+C.
translation_sync.nothing_to_cancel: No translation run is in progress to stop.
translation_sync.cancelled_note: The translation run was stopped. Nothing was imported on the server.
translation_sync.partial_saved_note: What was already translated is saved on the server. Start again to translate the rest.

corporate_units_cap_hint: Agreed maximum number of units for this organisation. Documents follow the same limit (maximum 1 per unit). On Corporate: «Save cap». Otherwise: «Activate Corporate» sets the plan and this limit.

errors.units_cap_invalid: Units cap must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
errors.not_corporate: This organisation is not on Corporate.
errors.ciao_requires_time: Turn on the Time module before CIAO.
